name: compute_cre_metrics
description: Compute underwritten NOI, DSCR, debt yield, LTV, breakeven occupancy and maximum loan sizing for a CRE deal from its extracted rent roll and T-12. Returns figures with citation anchors.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: compute_farm_cash_flow_stress
description: Compute farm cash available for debt service, term debt coverage, LTV, liquidity and a month-by-month seasonal cash-flow stress test for an agricultural deal.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: check_credit_policy
description: Compare computed metrics with credit policy and return flagged exceptions with rule ids. Flags are for analyst review, not a decision.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: get_evidence
description: List every citable figure for the deal with its citation anchor and value.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: verify_memo_citations
description: Check that every number in a memo draft is cited and matches the cited figure, and that the memo contains no credit-decision language.
